title: Verifiable Provenance and Watermarking for Generative AI: An Evidentiary Framework for International Operational Law and Domestic Courts
reasoning: The paper focuses on legal and forensic frameworks for verifying AI-generated content (image, audio, and video). While it discusses legal principles like the prohibition of perfidy and includes a standard Ethics Statement, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics as a core component of its research.
